description: This file defines the MalformedUriException class within the GuzzleHttp\Psr7\Exception namespace. It represents an exception that is thrown when a URI is malformed and cannot be parsed. The class extends InvalidArgumentException.

classes.name: MalformedUriException
classes.description: Exception thrown if a URI cannot be parsed because it's malformed.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Inherited from InvalidArgumentException, initializes the exception object.
